{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop rows where biomarker_baseline is -999.0 (sentinel value)
valid_data = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Confirm that the sentinel value is gone
print("Sentinel values in biomarker_baseline after filtering:", valid_data['biomarker_baseline'].unique())

# Check for duplicates based on patient_id
print("\nDuplicate patient_id count after filtering:", valid_data.duplicated(subset=['patient_id'], keep=False).sum())

# Now keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
valid_data = valid_data.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
valid_data = valid_data.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Compute the mean of biomarker_baseline on the cleaned data
mean_baseline_clean = valid_data['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f"\nMean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL): {mean_baseline_clean}")"}
